claude-code.notes: Claude Code's own shorthands for the `model` field; each resolves to the newest model of its class, so this row upgrades itself.

anthropic.notes: Dateless ids are pinned snapshots (no -latest). Fable 5.1 released 2026-09-01, Opus 5 2026-07-24, Sonnet 5 2026-06-30, Haiku 4.5 2025-10-01. Anthropic's guidance: start with Opus 5 and escalate to Fable 5.1 only when it falls short.

openai.notes: GPT-6 Astra released 2026-09-03; the 5.6 family 2026-07-09. `gpt-5.6` is an alias for Sol. Terra corresponds to the mini tier, Luna to nano. Confirmed against ~/.codex/models_cache.json on 2026-09-13.

google.notes: Gemini 3.8 Flash (GA 2026-09-02) is the newest and most capable documented model; the only 3.x Pro is the 3.1 preview from 2026-02-19. `-latest` aliases exist (e.g. gemini-flash-latest) and hot-swap on release. Gemini CLI's pro/flash aliases were stale in the docs on 2026-09-13; pin ids.

history.note: first registry, verified against the three official model pages and the local Codex model cache
